description: List the app infos belonging to an app. [GET /v1/apps/{id}/appInfos]

fields_appInfos.description: the fields to include for returned resources of type appInfos Return only these attributes. A full row set can exceed 200 KB.

id.description: App name, bundle ID (com.example.app) or numeric Apple ID.

include.description: comma-separated list of relationships to include Pull related records in the same call. Without it, checking a relationship costs one extra call per row returned.

next_url.description: Absolute links.next URL from a previous response.
